g.text: Ten-water circuit | feature blocks and molecular combinations
Sample w10_269547167027ff4be8a4 | Full-data joint training | best epoch 6 | angles in radians
Read left to right, then next panel. Colored regions = individual blocks; CZ = two connected dots.
Readout: X and Z on all 30 qubits (60 values). Every displayed gate is executed; all final gate choices are heuristic.
